notes: Kuzo 0.2.6 (trial - not approved under PRO-AIC-0608 C1). Review levels: every point above an LF (mV) or LMA (%) level the engineer sets is listed on every pass, on any file, and playback stops at each - a review aid only, nothing on the report. Pass B can be lined up on pass A on screen; LMA and LF shown as pass A, pass B and both together, each with its own cursor reading. The engineer can change the LF counting threshold (preview, Apply with a reason, logged, shown on the report). LF counts on a pass whose LF is not matched to WINTROS no longer decide the result. LF at the very ends of a pass shows "not available", never 0.0.
